decisions.reason: Having invested for several years in a product at the core of its secure second-channel communication strategy, management is likely to keep backing it and treat any weaker traction as a timing issue.
Because mobile signing remains central to the firm's stated move toward app-based interactions and online contract signing, prior R&D and customer-facing commitment still favor continuation.

This end-to-end security architecture is tightly linked to the firm's cryptographic core and likely supports multiple offerings, so sunk development costs and strategic centrality make withdrawal unlikely.
Although more specialized, it still reinforces the firm's secure messaging ecosystem and management can justify retaining it as a complementary solution for regulated clients.
As a hardware-oriented niche product that fits less well with the broader software-led ecosystem, its weaker strategic fit now outweighs earlier commitment and makes pruning the line likely.
